v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Lætáre, * Virgo Mater; surréxit Christus de sepúlcro.
text.en: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother, * Christ is risen from the grave.

text.la: Ascéndit Deus * in iubilatióne, et Dóminus in voce tubæ.
text.en: God is gone up with a shout, * and the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
The spirit of the Lord * hath filled the world.

text.la: Assúmpta est * María in cælum: gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum, allelúia.
text.en: Mary hath been taken to heaven. * The angels rejoice; they praise and bless the Lord. Alleluia.

text.la: Exaltáta est * Virgo María super choros Angelórum, et in cápite eius coróna stellárum duódecim.
text.en: The Virgin Mary * hath been exalted over choirs of angels, and upon her head there is a crown of twelve stars.

text.la: Solemnitátem hodiérnam * sacratíssimi Rosárii Genetrícis Dei Maríæ devóte celebrémus, ut ipsa pro nobis intercédat ad Dóminum Iesum Christum.
text.en: Let us this day keep * right heartily the solemn Feast of the Most Holy Rosary of Mary the Mother of God, that she may pray for us to our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.la: Deus, cuius Unigénitus per vitam, mortem et resurrectiónem suam nobis salútis ætérnæ prǽmia comparávit: concéde, quǽsumus; ut hæc mystéria sacratíssimo beátæ Maríæ Vírginis Rosário recoléntes, et imitémur quod cóntinent, et quod promíttunt, assequámur.
text.en: O God, Whose only-begotten Son, by His life, death and resurrection, has merited for us the grace of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that, meditating upon those mysteries in the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise.

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Marcum Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Mark thy Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.
